High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Graphics Text Attributes API.

Provides advanced text rendering control including text flow around screen edges and pagination for animating/scrolling text on round displays.

Imports

../ffi

Types

PagingConfig = object
  enabled*: bool             ## Whether pagination is enabled
  origin*: GPoint            ## Pagination reference point
  pageSize*: GSize           ## Size of each page
Configuration for pagination behavior 
TextFlowConfig = object
  inset*: uint8              ## Pixels to inset from screen edge (0 = disabled)
Configuration for text flow behavior

proc enablePaging(attrs: ptr GTextAttributes; origin: GPoint; pageRect: GRect) {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}

Enable pagination with a fixed reference point and page rectangle. Used for animating text or showing one "page" of text at a time.

origin - The reference point for pagination (usually bounds.origin) pageRect - The rectangle defining each page (usually bounds)

Equivalent to C function graphics_text_attributes_enable_paging(attrs, origin, page_rect).

proc enableScreenTextFlow(attrs: ptr GTextAttributes; inset: uint8) {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}

Enable text flow with the specified inset from screen edges. Text will wrap within an inset rectangle, useful on round screens where text shouldn't touch the screen edge.

The inset value defines how many pixels from the edge the text should stay. Typical values: 5-10 pixels for round displays.

Equivalent to C function graphics_text_attributes_enable_screen_text_flow(attrs, inset).

proc enableScreenTextFlowAndPaging(textLayer: ptr TextLayer; inset: uint8) {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}

Enable both text flow and paging on a TextLayer (one-shot convenience). This is the simplest way to enable round-screen text handling.

Must be called AFTER the TextLayer is added to the layer hierarchy.

Equivalent to C function text_layer_enable_screen_text_flow_and_paging(...).
